class.name: Vector3Spreener
class.brief_description: Interpolates an [Object]'s [Vector3] property based on the damping ratio and halflife of a spring.
class.description: [Vector3Spreener] is used to interpolate a [Vector3] property of an object. See [method Spreen.spreen_vector3]. [b]Note:[/b] [method Spreen.spreen_vector3] is the only correct way to create [Vector3Spreener]. Any [Vector3Spreener] created manually will not function correctly.

method.name: update_goal
method.description: Updates the goal of the [Vector3Spreener] in real time. When used in tandem with [method Spreen.set_finishable] can be used to dampen noisy inputs.
